description: Record a VM template that already exists on a node. template_id is the hypervisor template id, not a value to invent. cloud_init_template_id must already exist.

cloud_init_template_id.description: UUID of a Cloud-Init template that already exists. This tool does not create Cloud-Init scripts

template_id.description: Hypervisor template id already present on the node. Proxmox ids start at 100

name: create_vm_template
